services.name: Sun-damaged paint refinishing
services.blurb: Peeling roofs, hoods and trunks sanded to sound paint and refinished with a UV-rated clear.

services.name: Paint correction
services.blurb: Dull, swirled paint measured, then machine polished back to gloss without thinning the clear too far.

services.name: Hail dent repair
services.blurb: Every dent on the roof, hood and trunk counted, mapped and pushed out from behind.

services.name: Paintless dent removal
services.blurb: Door dings and small dents removed without paint, usually while you wait.

services.name: Collision repair
services.blurb: Fender benders on I-10 and Loop 375 repaired, with the claim steps and days written down.

services.name: Insurance claim help
services.blurb: You choose the shop. We send the photos, meet the adjuster and handle the supplement.

services.name: Paint matching and refinishing
services.blurb: Color read from your car, test sprayed, then checked in full sun before the panel goes on.

services.name: Bumper repair
services.blurb: Scuffed, cracked or pushed-in bumper covers repaired and painted to match the rest.

services.name: Headlight restoration
services.blurb: Sun-yellowed lenses cleared and sealed with a UV coat so they stay clear longer.

services.name: Ceramic coating
services.blurb: A hard, slick layer over corrected paint that slows the sun and makes dust rinse off.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The roof on my Camry was peeling like a sunburn. Graciela put a gauge on it, showed me the hood was still fine at factory thickness, and only refinished the roof and trunk. Saved me from painting the whole car.
reviews.name: Ruben C.

reviews.text: After the June hail they counted 41 dents and gave me the map with every one circled. Insurance paid it without a second inspection.
reviews.name: Adriana V.

reviews.text: I asked if my truck needed new paint or just a polish. They did a test spot on the tailgate, showed me the before and after reading, and it was just a polish. Honest answer, smaller bill.
reviews.name: Efrain G.

reviews.text: Rear-ended at the Zaragoza light. I didn't know I could pick my own shop until they explained it on the phone. They gave me a sheet with each step and how many days, and they hit every one.
reviews.name: Brenda L.

reviews.text: Headlights were so yellow I was driving Transmountain at night half blind. Forty minutes and they look like the day I bought the car.
reviews.name: Leonel R.

reviews.text: Had the coating put on after they corrected my black paint. Dust storms used to leave a film I had to scrub. Now a hose takes it off. Eight months in, still beading.
reviews.name: Krystal N.

reviews.text: Small crease in the passenger door from a parking lot at Cielo Vista. Pushed out in under an hour, no paint, and I watched them do it through the window.
reviews.name: Javier D.

proof.guarantee: If the color we match does not match in full daylight, we redo the panel at no charge.
